proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffectMechanics.operation → operations array
proposed_widenings.justification: Freedom of Movement grants 4–5 simultaneous persistent effects on the target. The current surface shape allows only one OngoingOperation. The field must become ReadonlyArray<OngoingOperation> to honestly encode multi-effect ongoing spells.
proposed_widenings.evidence: movement unaffected by Difficult Terrain; Speed cannot be reduced; Paralyzed and Restrained cannot be applied; gains Swim Speed; can spend 5 feet to escape — all simultaneous for 1 hour

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation: grant_movement_type
proposed_widenings.justification: Granting a Swim Speed equal to an existing Speed is a movement-type grant, not a numeric modifier or damage rider. v4 has the effect atom modify_speed but OngoingOperation has no variant that maps to it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target also has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation: terrain_immunity
proposed_widenings.justification: Ignoring difficult terrain entirely during movement is a passive movement flag. v4 has block_travel (for blocking movement to/through areas) but that atom's semantics are wrong — it blocks others from travelling through a zone, not granting a creature immunity to terrain costs. A new variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target's movement is unaffected by Difficult Terrain

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation: suppress_magical_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Blocking magic from reducing Speed or applying specific conditions is a suppress operation scoped to a source-type (magical) and effect-type (speed reduction, condition application). v4 has the suppress procedure atom but OngoingOperation has no suppress variant with source-filter and effect-filter fields.
proposed_widenings.evidence: spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's Speed nor cause the target to have the Paralyzed or Restrained conditions

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation: auto_escape_restraints
proposed_widenings.justification: Spending 5 feet of movement to automatically succeed at an escape attempt (from nonmagical restraints including Grappled condition) is not covered by any existing v4 effect atom. remove_condition requires the condition to already exist; this is a proactive escape triggered by the holder spending movement. A new effect kind is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature imposing the Grappled condition on it

notes: The ongoing_effect family is the correct high-level shape (timed, non-concentration, touch target). The blockers are entirely within the OngoingOperation surface type: (a) the single-operation field must become an array, and (b) four new operation variants are missing. The v4 atoms modify_speed and suppress exist and could back variants 1 and 3; terrain_immunity and auto_escape_restraints may require new v4 atoms as well. The higher-level target-count scaling (+1 creature per slot above 4) is already expressible via SlotScaling<number> on a choose_up_to attachment once multi-operation is supported.
